title: Your Revenue Can Grow While Your Business Gets Weaker
alternativeTitles: More Sales Won't Fix a Bad Business Model
Is Your Business Actually Profitable — or Just Busy?
The Business Model Test Most Entrepreneurs Skip
description:
More revenue does not automatically mean a healthier business. In this episode, we break down the structure behind a sustainable business model: margin, variable and fixed costs, delivery time, scalability, channel economics, and the difference between protecting a product format and protecting the customer need. You’ll also get a simple five-part audit and one stress-test question: if your sales doubled tomorrow, would the business genuinely become stronger?

Next episode: why your ideal customer is not “everyone.”
cta: Run the five-line business-model audit from the episode and choose one structural hypothesis to test for the next few weeks.
chapters: The Hidden Cost of Changing Channels
